policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: Qere nudi is a 2fs imperative addressed to the soul; the ketiv nudu is 2mp. English Flee inflects for neither person nor number, the ASV note at this word offers only the alternative rendering ye birds for har-kem tsippor, and the following your renders a 2mp suffix present in both readings. Nothing in the ASV distinguishes them, so the qere is retained as the documented base.
